Practised sorting numbers as odd or even by making pairs.
Used the ones digit to classify 247 and 47 as odd and 246 as even.
Explained that 7 makes 3 pairs with 1 left over.
Zero was initially called neither odd nor even; after correction, Jiya said zero is even.
Teach-back was not passed; unaided sorting was correct in 0 of 4 attempts.
end.parentNote: Jiya practised making pairs and checking whether one is left over. They explained clearly that 7 makes three pairs with 1 left over and used the ones digit for 247 and 47. There was a mix-up about zero, which Asha corrected later; Jiya then said zero is even. At home, practise pairing small groups including zero and ask, “Is anyone left over?”
